extracted_concepts.name: Second-Order Linear ODE
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linear differential equation of the form ay'' + by' + cy = 0 or = f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Homogeneous Equation with Constant Coefficients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The equation ay'' + by' + cy = 0 with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Characteristic Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The algebraic equation ar² + br + c = 0 used to solve constant-coefficient homogeneous ODEs.

extracted_concepts.name: Distinct Real Roots Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where the characteristic equation has two different real roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Repeated Root Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where the characteristic equation has one repeated root.

extracted_concepts.name: Complex Conjugate Roots Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where the characteristic equation has complex conjugate roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Nonhomogeneous Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A second-order linear ODE with a nonzero forcing term f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Method of Undetermined Coefficients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A method that guesses a particular solution y* based on the form of f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Variation of Parameters
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A method using y* = u₁y₁ + u₂y₂ where u₁', u₂' solve a system.

extracted_concepts.name: Spring-Mass System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mechanical model mx'' + cx' + kx = F(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Undamped Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spring-mass motion without damping, giving simple harmonic motion.

extracted_concepts.name: Damped Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spring-mass motion with exponential decay due to damping.

extracted_concepts.name: Forced Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spring-mass motion under an external driving force F(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Resonance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Large response when driving frequency is near natural frequency.

extracted_concepts.name: RLC Circuit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Electrical model LQ'' + RQ' + Q/C = E(t), analogous to spring-mass systems.

extracted_concepts.name: First-Order System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A system written as x' = Ax.

extracted_concepts.name: Coefficient Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The matrix A in the first-order system x' = Ax.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Exponential
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The expression e^(At) used in the solution x = e^(At)x₀.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A method that solves x' = Ax using eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A scalar λ associated with the coefficient matrix A.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A nonzero vector v associated with an eigenvalue λ.

extracted_concepts.name: Stable Node
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A qualitative phase-plane behavior determined by eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Spiral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A qualitative phase-plane behavior determined by eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Saddle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A qualitative phase-plane behavior determined by eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A qualitative phase-plane behavior determined by eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A differential equation involving partial derivatives of functions of several variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Wave Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The classical PDE u_tt = c²u_xx describing vibration, sound, and light.

extracted_concepts.name: Heat Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The classical PDE u_t = k u_xx describing diffusion and temperature.

extracted_concepts.name: Laplace Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The classical PDE u_xx + u_yy = 0 describing steady-state potentials.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A PDE method assuming u(x,t) = X(x)T(t) and separating into ODEs.

extracted_concepts.name: Fourier Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A series f(x) = a₀/2 + Σ[aₙcos(nπx/L) + bₙsin(nπx/L)].

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenfunction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function arising from separation of variables that forms part of an orthogonal system.

extracted_concepts.name: Complete Orthogonal System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A complete set of orthogonal eigenfunctions used in PDE series solutions.
